gate_iii_rule: Clarification (Artem, 2026-11-09, before any Stage 1 call): gate (iii) applies to calls that close </think> and stop; it fails if any such call is invalid, or if any call ends with EOS inside reasoning. Truncated alpha = 0 calls are reported by count, do not fail (iii), and count as non-adoption and non-fit in every measure, as in the battery.
